messages:
Priya: Heads-up — inbound queue showing contacts stuck with enrichment_status=blank and no owner in SF. SLA % dropped last night.
Ethan: I saw similar last week when an SDR was deactivated but still in the HubSpot owner pool. Round-robin kept cycling to that id and assignment failed.
Sam: Short-term: can we add a validation step before final assignment that checks owner exists + active? If not, route to a fallback group and set an ownership timestamp.
Lina: Good call. Also we should standardize enrichment output to "n/a" instead of blank so workflows can evaluate reliably. Small change in the enrichment webhook.
Priya: Proposed immediate changes:
1) HubSpot workflow: after enrichment wait 20m if enrichment_status != "complete" then assign to fallback-inbound-review and set property ownership_assigned_ts.
2) Pre-assignment validation: check owner_candidate.id exists in SF and user.status == 'Active'. If validation fails -> fallback.
3) Update round-robin to filter out users with last_login > 14d ago, license_type='read-only' or tag 'ooo'.
Ethan: I'll update the round-robin logic and push to staging. Sam: can you implement the HubSpot validation and ownership_assigned_ts?
Sam: Yep. Also I'll add a Slack webhook alert to #sales-ops when a contact goes to fallback so triage can happen fast.
Lina: I'll change enrichment payload to emit "n/a" for missing profiles and add enrichment_reason field = 'no_profile' or 'manual_review'.
Priya: Who owns the playbook? I'll write a 1-pager for SDRs: steps to claim inbound-review leads and SLA of 1 business hour.
ops-bot: HubSpot workflow update scheduled by Sam at 2026-04-10T14:02:00Z (wflow-314).
Ethan: Round-robin filter deployed to staging. Will run a dry run to ensure no false negatives.
Sam: Validation step deployed to staging, webhook to #sales-ops tested.
Lina: Enrichment change live. New leads set enrichment_status='n/a' when missing.
Priya: Quick verification: new test leads either assigned to live SDRs or hit fallback with ownership_assigned_ts set. SLA timer now visible on the marketing dashboard.
Ethan: We'll monitor 48h for failures and then flip to prod.
Priya: Thanks team — closing once 48h watch is green and playbook posted. :white_check_mark:
